additions.content:
{
  "extension.displayName": "Path Intellisense",
  "extension.description": "Visual Studio Code plugin that autocompletes filenames",
  "configuration.title": "path-intellisense",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.extensionOnImport.description": "Adds the file extension to a import statements",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.mappings.description": "Mappings for paths.  The values should be interpreted as absolute paths (and can use '${workspaceFolder}')",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.showHiddenFiles.description": "Show hidden files",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.autoSlashAfterDirectory.description": "Automatically adds slash after directory",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.absolutePathToWorkspace.description": "Sets an absolute path to the current workspace",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.absolutePathTo.description": "If defined, unmapped absolute path imports are based on this location.  Takes priority over 'absolutePathToWorkspace' if both are defined",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.showOnAbsoluteSlash.description": "Shows suggestions when the import starts with a forward slash ('/')",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.ignoreTsConfigBaseUrl.description": "Ignores tsconfig file for mappings",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.autoTriggerNextSuggestion.description": "Automatically triggers next suggestion after previous suggestion"
}

{
  "extension.displayName": "Path Intellisense",
  "extension.description": "自动补全文件名的 Visual Studio Code 插件",
  "configuration.title": "Path Intellisense",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.extensionOnImport.description": "在 import 语句中添加文件扩展名",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.mappings.description": "路径映射。映射值按绝对路径解析（可使用 '${workspaceFolder}'）",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.showHiddenFiles.description": "显示隐藏文件",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.autoSlashAfterDirectory.description": "自动在目录后添加斜杠",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.absolutePathToWorkspace.description": "将绝对路径的起点设为当前工作区",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.absolutePathTo.description": "指定后，未映射的绝对路径导入将以此位置为起点。与 'absolutePathToWorkspace' 同时设置时，此项优先",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.showOnAbsoluteSlash.description": "导入路径以正斜杠（'/'）开头时显示建议",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.ignoreTsConfigBaseUrl.description": "忽略 tsconfig 文件中的路径映射",
  "configuration.path-intellisense.autoTriggerNextSuggestion.description": "完成一次补全后自动触发下一次建议"
}
